The heat has 
not improved. 

On the contrary, it feels like the temperature has only gone up. 

§5I§0 am confident that this place does in fact continue upwards, despite the recursion.

§5I§0 wipe the sweat from

§5I’ve§0 been walking for a little bit since §5I§0 finished writing. 

§5I§0 don’t think 
§5I’ve§0 made much progress, though. 

The heat is making

it very difficult to move for long periods of time. 

In spite of how little §5I§0 can bear this heat, §5I§0 feel a deep satisfaction from §5my§0 work. 

The feeling of accomplishment is unparalleled.

The joy of expressing §5my§0 frustration through a story makes dealing with this situation a little bit easier. 

§5I’ve§0 finished §5my§0 first story now, but before §5I§0 could begin to write something new, §5I§0 noticed a very strange set of notes in the pages.

Nearly every page has foot notes, annotations, references, underlines, 
and writing in 
the margins about everything from 
the topics, to 
the grammar.

Things that §5I§0 hold no memories of writing.

Has §5my§0 amnesia gone from long to short term? 

No, this can’t 
be the case. 


§5I§0 remember all of what §5I’ve§0 experienced so far. 

This has to be      But someone else.     §5who§0?

How did they manage to write into the book while §5I§0 was holding it? 

The notes themselves are extremely meticulous.

The amount of detail put into these notes can only be described as obsessive.§5

§5I§0 am a bit uncomfortable with the level of scrutiny §5my§0 work has been put under. 

It’s like they want to find any possible flaw in §5my§0 work. 

Criticism aside, this doesn’t make sense.

§5I’ve§0 not seen

anybody here, but §5I§0 somehow have evidence of them. 

Evidence that contradicts what §5I’ve§0 come to understand about this place. 

More importantly, why have they gone the route of review? 

Instead of writing to

§5me§0, they’re 
critiquing §5my§0 work.

§5I§0 need to find out more. 

If they are responding to §5my§0 writing, then they can surely see anything

else §5I§0 put here. §5I§0 flip to the first blank page and begin writing into it.

§5I§0 sit anxiously 
waiting for an 
answer. 


One that §5I§0 divert §5my§0 attention away from, in favor of something much more alarming. A new sensation that §5I§0 have not felt before, nor could §5I§0 have anticipated this could ever happen.

Something has alerted §5my§0 olfactory system. 

Beyond the incandescent heat, 
the air is becoming saturated with something else. 

Murky, dark poison that §5my§0 nose is being forced to drink.

§8Smoke.§0 



§5My§0 lungs fill with wretched, nocuous miasma. 

There’s no mistaking it. 
The stairwell is beginning to fill with smoke.

But how? 

Where is this 
coming from? 

How could a 
fire start here? 

Is this because 
of the heat? 

Or was the heat because of the approaching fire?

That makes no sense. 

That would mean the fire has been raging on for god knows how long. 

It doesn’t matter, because as soon as the concept of burning up enters §5my§0 head, §5I§0 am filled with unimaginable panic.

§5My§0 mysterious editor can wait for now. 

§5I§0 bolt up to §5my§0 feet, but pause. 

Where do §5I§0 go? 

§5I§0 don’t know where this fire is. 

Heat rises, pushing that smoke up.

But if the smoke is rising and filling the air, then the fire must be below §5me§0…? 

That can’t 
be the case. 

It’s gotten hotter as §5I’ve§0 gone up, implying the fire is below §5me§0. 

But then, how does the smoke float down?

§5I§0 decide to go up. 

The ascent has not betrayed §5me§0 yet. 

§5I §0storm up the steps, clutching 
§6Arches of Yarn§0 
to §5my§0 chest with §5my§0 left arm, §5my§0 right hand covering §5my§0 face in a desperate attempt to breathe in less of the smoke.

God, why a fire? 

The heat feels blistering. 

§5I§0 still don’t see the fire, but the smoke seems to be getting denser. 

§5I§0 can barely breathe, and §5I§0 cough and sputter as §5my§0 stamina drains.

§5I§0 can’t even see the shadow at the top of the steps anymore. 

§5I§0 can only see a few flights in front of §5me§0. 

For some reason, the idea of a fire is filling §5me§0 with a particularly unique kind of fear. 

Fear in a circumstance like this

is a completely natural experience, but this feels far 
sharper than fear. 

Why the hell is this happening to §5me§0? 

Finally, it breaches the cloud of gray. 


There it is.

The tongues of the fire reside on the steps before §5me§0, bright orange whips cracking against the air. 

It writhes and coils and roars before §5me§0, covering the walls, the shelves, the books, the wooden floorboards.

It almost 
looks alive. 

§5I§0 stop where 
§5I§0 stand, paralyzed. 

It’s looking at §5me§0. 
§5I§0 don’t know how. 
But §5I§0 know it perceives §5me§0. 

It wants §5me§0. The fire wants §5me§0. 
§5I§0 can sense it.
